products.name: Replicate
products.note: Model hosting and inference API; open-source models; community models; content policy

profile_text.body:
Replicate is a cloud platform that lets developers and businesses run machine learning models through an API. The company describes itself as a way to deploy AI features quickly and scale to millions of users without requiring in-house machine learning expertise. Its platform hosts open-source models from third parties, including models from OpenAI, Anthropic, ByteDance, and Krea, covering image generation, video generation, and general language tasks.

Beyond hosted models, Replicate offers Cog, an open-source tool for packaging and deploying custom machine learning models. Users can write a predictor class, load their own weights, and push the result to Replicate's infrastructure. The platform also provides metrics and logging so developers can monitor model performance and debug individual predictions.

The site's held facts list Replicate's primary product as a model hosting and inference API with support for open-source and community models, governed by a content policy. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
